items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: we played for CHAPPELLE and Stinnette

ctx.x: And it was the first time she had ever been on a New York stage too, see? And Clarence Williams -- they had an act, and they was on the same bill, and we played for CHAPPELLE and Stinnette And so we did a very good -- that was the first week we ever been on the stage. From then on I thought I was somebody.
Later on, when I left there, they were looking for -- a second show, "Plantation Days". James P. Johnson had the first show.
